# We have the note content. Now we'll construct the updated content with release months.
# We have release dates from our earlier searches. Let's map each song to its release month/year.

release_months = {
    "Lost in the Embrace of Night": "03/2021",
    "Lonely Skies": "11/2022",
    "Caught in a Web of Lies": "03/2021",
    "On the Border of Reality": "08/2022",
    "A Love That Never Was": "10/2020",
    "Astral Serenity": "12/2019",
    "Between Reality and Reverie": "03/2020",
    "Strangers Again": "06/2022",
    "The Mirage of a Perfect Life": "11/2020",
    "Wilted Roses on the Vine": "02/2020",
    "When All Words Fail Us": "07/2020",
    "Final Echo": "07/2022"
}

# The note content is a string. We'll split by lines and replace TODO with the correct month.
content = note['content']
lines = content.split('\n')
new_lines = []
for line in lines:
    if 'RELEASED_AT TODO' in line:
        # Extract song title from the line. Format: "- Song Title BY artists RELEASED_AT TODO"
        # We'll find the part between "- " and " BY"
        song_title = line.split('- ')[1].split(' BY')[0]
        month = release_months.get(song_title)
        if month:
            line = line.replace('RELEASED_AT TODO', f'RELEASED_AT {month}')
        else:
            print(f"Warning: No release month found for {song_title}")
    new_lines.append(line)

new_content = '\n'.join(new_lines)
print(new_content)
